# FoodDrink
Mobile-first food & drink ordering platform for students.

## Key Pages
- `/` — Redirects to beranda (home)
- `/beranda` — Home page with banners, categories, popular products
- `/produk` — Product listing with filters and search
- `/keranjang` — Shopping cart with quantity management
- `/checkout` — Checkout with delivery options and payment methods
- `/checkout/success/[id]` — Order confirmation and receipt
- `/pesanan` — Order history and tracking
- `/akun` — User account management
- `/akun/profil` — Profile settings
- `/akun/favorit` — Favorite products
- `/akun/notifikasi` — Notifications
- `/akun/pengaturan` — App settings
- `/notifikasi` — Notification center
- `/login` — Login page (email/phone + password)
- `/register` — Registration page
- `/verify` — OTP verification
- `/forgot-password` — Password reset

## Admin Pages
- `/admin` — Admin dashboard
- `/admin/menu` — Menu management
- `/admin/kategori` — Category management
- `/admin/banner` — Banner management
- `/admin/pesanan` — Order management
- `/admin/reviews` — Review moderation
- `/admin/notifikasi` — Notification management

## API Endpoints
- `POST /api/checkout` — Create order with Midtrans payment
- `POST /api/midtrans/notification` — Midtrans webhook handler
- `GET /api/orders/[id]` — Get order details
- `POST /api/upload-image` — Upload product images
- `POST /api/logout` — User logout

## Features
- User authentication (email/phone + password, OTP)
- Product catalog with categories
- Shopping cart with quantity picker
- Multiple delivery methods (delivery to class, self-pickup)
- Payment via Midtrans (online) or COD (cash on delivery)
- Order tracking with real-time status
- Product reviews and ratings
- Favorites/wishlist
- Push notifications
- Receipt generation (print/share)

## Technical Stack
- Next.js 14 (App Router, Server Components)
- React 18, TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Realtime)
- Midtrans Payment Gateway
- Framer Motion for animations
